verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's evidence is entirely about engineers/technical operators configuring workspaces, remote daemons, CLI tools, and ticket integrations (Jira/Linear/GitHub) to drive coding agents — there is no evidence of a mockup/design ingestion capability, no-code PM-facing workflow, or any claim that a non-engineer can go from a visual design to working code without engineering setup. The setup steps (workspace.json, remote daemons, host selection, sub-agent config) actually imply an engineering handoff is required, not eliminated.
